verdict.rationale: AFK is a SaaS operations-automation platform, so a developer platform or SDK for custom connectors is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows prebuilt integrations (Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe), and nothing documents an SDK, CLI, or way to build private connectors. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI
